name: .411 Cal-377gr Stone Hammer®
note: Minimum required twist for Dangerous Game is 1-14″ for faster. Minimum required twist for Big Game is 1-16″ or faster. Recommended use: Big Game and Dangerous Game Hunting. The product page also says: "This is our heaviest of the .411 Cal Hammer Bullets. It is a bit longer in the nose, so will likely be a bit long for the 405 Winchester lever actions. It should work well in the single shot rifles as well as bolt actions. This will be a great option for guys that have built dangerous game rifles based on other cartridges with the .411 caliber. With the 3mm Lever Hammer design hollow point, this will be a very hard hitting bullet."
